name: Blocks Product Editor for WooCommerce
author: ethereumicoio

sections.description:
Blocks Product Editor for WooCommerce plugin enables the Gutenberg Editor for WooCommerce products.

FREE Features

  • Enable or disable the Gutenberg Editor for WooCommerce products

PRO Features

The PRO version includes all FREE features, plus:

  • The Catalog visibility metabox, so the “Catalog visibility” and “Featured” product settings are available next to the other product data instead of only in the sidebar
  • A per-product switch back to the classic editor – the store keeps the block editor for products in general, but a single product can still be edited the old way
  • Restricting the block editor to selected user roles, so e.g. shop managers can keep the classic editor
  • Restricting the block editor to selected product types, so e.g. only simple products are edited in blocks
  • The rich “Product short description” box – the short description gets the full WordPress editor instead of a plain textarea

sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: the PRO version can switch a single product back to the classic editor, while the rest of the store keeps the block editor.
  • New: the PRO version can limit the block editor to selected user roles and to selected product types.
  • New: the PRO version brings the product short description to the full WordPress editor instead of a plain textarea.
  • Fixed: the PRO feature list no longer advertises the REST switches for tags and categories – WooCommerce has made those taxonomies REST-enabled itself, so the switches did nothing.
  • The settings page now lists the PRO features that actually exist, and only on the versions that have them.

1.1.0

  • The plugin was rebuilt on the layered architecture the other plugins of this family use (app/ with modules, domain, views and controllers). Settings, hooks and behaviour on the product screens are unchanged.
  • New: wp bpe enable, wp bpe disable and wp bpe status switch the editor from the console – the way out when the product screen itself is what broke.
  • New: uninstalling the plugin now removes its settings; deactivating still keeps them.
  • Fixed: on a multisite network with network-activated WooCommerce the plugin deactivated itself, because it only looked at the per-site plugin list.
  • Fixed: the product post type template is only removed on the WooCommerce versions that ship one (7.7 – 10.x).
  • Requires WordPress 6.6+, PHP 7.4+ and WooCommerce 8.0+.

1.0.6

  • Declared compatibility with the WooCommerce “High-Performance order storage” feature: the plugin no longer shows the incompatibility warning and no longer blocks enabling HPOS in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Features.
  • Added the Requires Plugins: woocommerce header, so WordPress itself reports the missing WooCommerce dependency.

1.0.5

  • freemius library version update
  • tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2

1.0.4

1.0.1

  • WC 7.7.0 support.

1.0.0
